question: Who among the following was conferred with the Padma Shri Award 2025 in the field of Literature and Education in April 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Prof. Anil Kumar Boro**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Prof. Anil Kumar Boro was conferred with the prestigious Padma Shri Award 2025 in the field of Literature and Education.
 
• He is a renowned academician and writer, known for his contributions to the promotion and preservation of indigenous languages and literature.
 
• Prof. Boro's work primarily revolves around the Bodo language and its literature, playing a pivotal role in its development and recognition.
 
• The Padma Shri Award is one of India’s highest civilian honors, given for distinguished contributions in various fields, including art, literature, education, and public service.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Bodo Language:**

 
 
• Bodo is an indigenous language spoken primarily in Assam and northeastern India.
 
• It belongs to the Tibeto-Burman language family and is recognized as one of the 22 scheduled languages of India.
 
• The language has a rich tradition of oral and written literature, including poetry, folk tales, and modern literary works.
 
 
 
• **Padma Awards:**
 
 
• The Padma Awards, including Padma Shri, Padma Bhushan, and Padma Vibhushan, are announced annually on India’s Republic Day.
 
• The awards are given to individuals for their exceptional contributions in various fields like art, literature, science, sports, and social work.
 
• Padma Shri is the fourth highest civilian award in India.
 
 
 
• **Promoting Indigenous Literature:**
 
 
• Efforts to promote indigenous literature aim to preserve cultural identity and linguistic diversity.
 
• Academicians like Prof. Anil Kumar Boro contribute significantly to keeping lesser-known languages alive through research and education.
 
 
 
• **Significance of Literature in Education:**
 
 
• Literature plays a crucial role in shaping educational frameworks and fostering critical thinking among learners.
 
• It serves as a medium to understand diverse cultures, histories, and human experiences.
